tasks.title: Verify the complete initial package and capability graph
tasks.goal: Reconcile all accepted initial-route captures, versions and external coverage before integration.
steps: Collect accepted M-01…M-11, M-13, M-14-C and M-17-A evidence, exact source captures and actual supported capability rows.
Resolve a composed local fixture containing Redbook choices, both bridges, four external adapters, local derivatives and native examples; verify every incoming edge and active owned 1.0.0 identity.
Join initial ETO/API coverage with real domain cases, recording missing results as open instead of substituting a supported-but-unimplemented row.
positive_cases: The full initial graph resolves to the exact accepted captures and choices.
Every supported initial operation/model has independent external evidence from M-17-A.
negative_cases: Mixed capture, wrong own version, missing bridge resource or unsupported mandatory client blocks readiness.
This gate cannot report M-15 or full M-17 done.
checks: SELECT BEFORE DISPATCH: vibe-install target/cases are TO BIND from source/metadata to affected positive/negative obligations; choose --lib, --test <name>, --bin <name>, or affected --doc before compiling.

RUN BOUND CHECKS: after binding, use cargo test -p vibe-install <target> <case> -- --exact for lib/test/bin, or a reviewed small family without --exact; bind supported rustdoc selection separately. Verify intended nonzero cases in output; use target-specific --list only when needed to confirm selection, and reuse its valid inventory.

Declared selected state matches actual installed/projection subjects.
tasks.safe_stop: Initial integration census is complete; remaining route evidence is explicitly open.

notes: External bridge roots require root-bound isolated checkouts for external:org.speckit.speckit / external:skills-bridge-to-select. Never modify the currently existing sibling source trees. Root binds actual external validation/publication commands after inspecting those checkouts.
fixtures/next/integration is a proposed controlled fixture subtree.

tasks.title: Reproduce the accepted initial graph offline
tasks.goal: Prove a clean isolated consumer can replay exact initial-route inputs and behaviors.
steps: Prepare complete captures from .1 into a controlled source/cache fixture; then replay in a second clean injected home with network/process counters.
Compare resulting lock, full package resources, boot contributions, derivatives, adapter receipts and native example evidence against the accepted graph.

Exercise missing-capture and changed-definition cases with bound replay/capture checks. Escalate to the full self-check only for demonstrated nonlocal impact with no adequate narrower proof, using root-provided environment isolation; the designated final campaign gate remains separate.
positive_cases: Prepared offline replay reproduces exact selected sources/resources and declared operations.
Two clean consumers keep independent ownership while sharing allowed captured content.
negative_cases: Offline missing input cannot trigger fetch/default reselect.
Byte-equal output alone cannot substitute for capture/receipt ownership agreement.
